basic_info.description:
The Avery is sharp, ultra luxurious, convenient and at a central location for the city lover! This brand new condo comes fully furnished and is one of very few of the condos for rent at The Avery and is ready for immediate move in.

This condo comes fully furnished with the furniture in the photos

Condo Features
~ Over 900 SQFT of living space
~ Furnishings are high end from Restoration Hardware
~ Gourmet kitchen with Miele stainless steel kitchen appliances
~ Open planned living room with entertainment wall
~ Hardwood floors throughout
~ Floor to ceiling windows with stunning city and bay views
~ Large bedroom with walk in closet
~ California closets in unit
~ 1.5 bathrooms with luxury finishes
~ Electronic blinds
~ Sonos sound system throughout
~ Fully automated lighting
~ Washer and dryer in unit
~ AC in unit - Nest Climate Controlled
~ One valet parking included in rent
~ Tenant is responsible for move in / move out fee
~ This condo has exclusive access to the private Owners Floor which includes exclusive access to the owners only Gym, lounge and entertainment area

~ Building Features
~ Precision trained staff are available 24 hours a day to cater to every whim or need
~ 24/7 valet parking in private on- site garage
~ Package room with refrigerated storage
~ In home package delivery
~ Pet Spa
~ Exclusive use - car share service
~ Hello Alfred - Laundry and shopping service
~ Bicycle storage with maintenance station
Lifestyle
~ Equinox curated gym
~ Indoor lap pool
~ Yoga room
~ Sky terrace
~ Chef's area
~ Entertainment area
~ Business lounge
